meta.title: Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks: refused for a user without the Compliance Officer role
gaps: Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.
Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and as a Compliance Officer in the same tenant.
Use Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks during vendor onboarding with a group-entity email domain or PAN, and compare refusal or availability between the two roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.; Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and as a Compliance Officer in the same tenant.; Use Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks during vendor onboarding with a group-entity email domain or PAN, and compare refusal or availability between the two roles.
